question: Compare Notion and Atlassian Confluence on team knowledge management

findings.claim: Notion describes its knowledge management programme.
findings.evidence: Notion states that its knowledge management programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: Notion platform overview

findings.claim: Confluence describes its knowledge management programme.
findings.evidence: Confluence states that its knowledge management programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: Confluence platform overview

findings.evidence: Both Notion and Confluence report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts Notion's in-house delivery with Confluence's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: Notion discloses investment in knowledge management capability.
findings.evidence: Notion discloses continued investment in knowledge management training and certification.
findings.title: Notion investment disclosure

findings.claim: Confluence discloses investment in knowledge management capability.
findings.evidence: Confluence discloses continued investment in knowledge management delivery centres.
findings.title: Confluence investment disclosure

sections.heading: How Notion and Confluence organise knowledge management
sections.body: Notion runs knowledge management through a dedicated unit, while Confluence organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Notion and Confluence report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in knowledge management capability, though in different places. The evidence conclusively proves that one product is better for every enterprise buyer.

claims.text: Notion delivers knowledge management work through a dedicated business unit.
Confluence organises knowledge management work around partner platforms.
Both Notion and Confluence report multi-year platform partnerships.
Notion and Confluence both disclose continued knowledge management investment.

verdicts.quote: Notion states that its knowledge management programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
Confluence states that its knowledge management programme is organised around partner platforms.
Both Notion and Confluence report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
Notion discloses continued investment in knowledge management training and certification.

notes: KNOWN DEFECT: the report asserts certainty its evidence does not carry. forbidden_claim_absence should catch the phrase.
